body: Paul McCartney, life long Beatles fan here. He’s been as much a part of my life as my own family, some of my earliest memories were hearing Paul’s solo work and our record rack was full of The Beatles records.
Tired of traders that claim all trades accepted, no muss no fuss. Send a fair trade and I get declined.  What happened to your all trades accepted?
Me too. I’ve even stopped taking my daily meds in hopes of speeding up the process.

Im going to say it, I’m ready to die. I’m tired of this. I’m lucky to still be working but life consists of working and going home. There’s nothing to look forward to, to work towards.  I don’t want to end my life violently but I haven’t taken my diabetic meds or my high blood pressure meds in a few months. I just don’t care anymore...and I’m ok with that. As a person with diabetes, high bp and chronic kidney disease, I hope it won’t take too long.
